Carla CSM: Heads-up — onboarding customers in the high-touch cohort are seeing intermittent 502s and slow token exchange during the VPC auth step since 07:45 UTC. :warning:
Miguel Ops: on it, investigating whether it's auth proxy or the token service. I have a tracing span up.
Jane Eng: I see elevated 5xx from the auth-pool-2 during that window, errors look like timeouts to our KMS facade.
Tom Support: any confirmed affected tenants list? I can start outreach for those in active trials.
Carla CSM: Priya, can you surface the 12 highest-risk accounts (onboarded last 30 days + renewal in Q2) so we prioritize outreach?
Priya AM: pulling now — will DM the list.
Eli (CS Manager): We need a short customer-facing status for high-touch and a separate bulletin for self-serve. Keep it concise: impact, ETA, mitigation, next steps.
Carla CSM: Draft for high-touch (please edit): "We are investigating intermittent onboarding failures affecting token exchange for some VPC/on-prem onboarding flows. Our engineers are working on a fix; we will provide updates every 30 minutes. If this affects your integration, reply here and we'll open a priority support ticket."
Miguel Ops: I suggest adding known workaround: "If you're able to switch to the hosted token flow temporarily (instructions link), that will bypass the KMS facade." Link: https://redwood.ai/docs/vpc-auth-fallback
Jane Eng: RCA tentative: KMS facade started returning 504s due to a connection leak in facade-client after a recent rolling deploy. Root cause is a goroutine that didn't close the connection on certain retry paths. Rollback of facade client deployment mitigates immediate failures.
Carla CSM: Nice. Can you distill that to customer language (no internal tech jargon)? e.g., "a recent infrastructure update led to transient failures when exchanging tokens; we've rolled back the update and are monitoring"
Jane Eng: Yes — propose: "We rolled back a recent update that caused transient token exchange failures. The rollout is complete and monitoring shows reduced errors; we’ll keep watching and follow up with an RCA."
Tom Support: I pushed the draft into the CS outbound tracker and flagged the 12 accounts Priya sent as P1 for phone follow-up.
DeployBot: rollback-deploy succeeded for service "kms-facade" on cluster prod-a at 08:02 UTC (deploy id: dpl-78321).
Miguel Ops: Post-rollback metrics: 5xx rate on auth-pool-2 returned to baseline within ~3 minutes. Latency p50 back to normal.
Priya AM: Outreach plan: 1) send tailored note to 12 high-risk accounts (phone + email) 2) segmented broadcast to remaining high-touch list 3) KB article link + optional office hours.
Carla CSM: Assignments: Priya to send phone/email to high-risk, Tom to open priority tickets for any tenant reporting issues, Eli to craft exec summary for renewals team.
Eli (CS Manager): Will draft exec summary: impact, number of affected seats, remediation performed, mitigation credits proposal if any.
Carla CSM: Finalize customer copy below (one-line + follow-up):

Carla CSM: ```
Hi <CustomerName>,
We're reaching out because some customers experienced intermittent onboarding failures during token exchange earlier today. We identified and rolled back an infrastructure update that caused the issue; the rollback is complete and error rates have returned to normal. If you saw failures, we've opened a priority ticket and can assist with re-running the onboarding flow. We apologize for the disruption — please reply or call your CSM if you'd like immediate help.
```

Tom Support: I'll attach the support ticket template and triage checklist to each outbound.
Jane Eng: Follow-ups for engineering: 1) add connection leak test to CI 2) instrument retry paths with stricter timeouts 3) postmortem with timeline and blame-free action items.
Miguel Ops: ETA for permanent fix (non-rollback): PR open, running canary, target deploy in 24-48h pending green canary.
Carla CSM: Communications cadence: initial outbound now, 30-min status update to affected, 1hr update with monitoring screenshot, final note with RCA and credits within 48h.
Priya AM: I'll log feedback from calls in the shared sheet: https://docs.redwood.ai/sheets/onboard-incident-feedback
Eli (CS Manager): Keep me looped on any signal that a customer is at renewal risk because of this — we'll escalate to sales ops and legal if they request credits.
Carla CSM: Thanks everyone. After this thread I'll send the finalized messages and copy for support to use. :thumbsup:
Miguel Ops: closing loop — will post final monitoring screenshot in 15m.
DeployBot: monitor-alert: auth-pool-2 5xx-rate dropped to baseline at 08:05 UTC.
Carla CSM: Last: please add a short survey question to the post-incident note — capture whether customers needed hands-on help so we can quantify enablement load. Suggested wording: "Did you require live assistance to complete onboarding due to this issue? (Yes/No)"
Tom Support: added survey field to the ticket form.
Carla CSM: Thread locked after final outbound. Thanks all.
